cues: Set up in a power rack with the bar on the pins.
The pins should be set to the desired point.
just below the knees.
Position yourself against the bar in proper deadlifting position.

suspended-reverse-crunch-2.name: Suspended Reverse Crunch
cues: Secure a set of suspension straps with the handles hanging about a foot off of the ground.
Move yourself into a pushup plank position facing away from the rack.

scissors-jump-2.name: Scissors Jump
cues: Assume a lunge stance position with one foot forward with the knee bent.
and the rear knee nearly touching the ground.

peroneals-smr-2.name: Peroneals-SMR
cues: Lay on your side.
supporting your weight on your forearm and on a foam roller placed on the outside of your lower leg.
Your upper leg can either be on top of your lower leg, or you can cross it in front of you.
This will be your starting position.

alternating-deltoid-raise-2.name: Alternating Deltoid Raise
cues: In a standing position, hold a pair of dumbbells at your side.

hammer-grip-incline-db-bench-press-2.name: Hammer Grip Incline DB Bench Press
cues: Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs.
The palms of your hand will be facing each other.

overhead-triceps-2.name: Overhead Triceps
cues: Sit upright on the floor with your partner behind you.
Raise one arm straight up, and flex the elbow, attempting to touch your hand to your back.
Your parner should hold your elbow and wrist.
This will be your starting position.

hug-knees-to-chest-2.name: Hug Knees To Chest
cues: Lie down on your back and pull both knees up to your chest.

leverage-decline-chest-press-2.name: Leverage Decline Chest Press
cues: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height.
The handles should be near the bottom of the pectorals at the beginning of the motion.
Your chest and head should be up and your shoulder blades retracted.
This will be your starting position.

dumbbell-one-arm-triceps-extension-2.name: Dumbbell One-Arm Triceps Extension
cues: Grab a dumbbell and either sit on a military press bench or a utility bench that has a back support on it as you place the dumbbells upright on top of your thighs or stand up straight.

barbell-walking-lunge-2.name: Barbell Walking Lunge
cues: Begin standing with your feet shoulder width apart and a barbell across your upper back.

press-sit-up-2.name: Press Sit-Up
cues: To begin, lie down on a bench with a barbell resting on your chest.
Position your legs so they are secure on the extension of the abdominal bench.
This is the starting position.

walking-treadmill-2.name: Walking, Treadmill
cues: To begin, step onto the treadmill and select the desired option from the menu.
Most treadmills have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run.
Typically.
you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise.

standing-olympic-plate-hand-squeeze-2.name: Standing Olympic Plate Hand Squeeze
cues: To begin.
stand straight while holding a weight plate by the ridge at arm's length in each hand using a neutral grip (palms facing in).
You feet should be shoulder width apart from each other.
This will be your starting position.

weighted-ball-hyperextension-2.name: Weighted Ball Hyperextension
cues: To begin.
lie down on an exercise ball with your torso pressing against the ball and parallel to the floor.
The ball of your feet should be pressed against the floor to help keep you balanced.
Place a weighted plate under your chin or behind your neck.

side-neck-stretch-2.name: Side Neck Stretch
cues: Start with your shoulders relaxed, gently tilt your head towards your shoulder.

ankle-on-the-knee-2.name: Ankle On The Knee
cues: From a lying position, bend your knees and keep your feet on the floor.

on-your-side-quad-stretch-2.name: On Your Side Quad Stretch
cues: Start off by lying on your right side.
with your right knee bent at a 90-degree angle resting on the floor in front of you (this stabilizes the torso).

decline-push-up-2.name: Decline Push-Up
cues: Lie on the floor face down and place your hands about 36 inches apart while holding your torso up at arms length.
Move your feet up to a box or bench.
This will be your starting position.

deadlift-with-chains-2.name: Deadlift with Chains
cues: You can attach the chains to the sleeves of the bar.
or just drape the middle over the bar so there is a greater weight increase as you lift.

pull-through-2.name: Pull Through
cues: Begin standing a few feet in front of a low pulley with a rope or handle attached.
Face away from the machine, straddling the cable, with your feet set wide apart.

sled-drag-harness-2.name: Sled Drag - Harness
cues: To begin, load the sled with the desired weight and attach the pulling strap.
You can pull with handles, use a harness, or attach the pulling strap to a weight belt.

flat-bench-lying-leg-raise-2.name: Flat Bench Lying Leg Raise
cues: Lie with your back flat on a bench and your legs extended in front of you off the end.

triceps-pushdown-2.name: Triceps Pushdown
cues: Attach a straight or angled bar to a high pulley and grab with an overhand grip (palms facing down) at shoulder width.

natural-glute-ham-raise-2.name: Natural Glute Ham Raise
cues: Using the leg pad of a lat pulldown machine or a preacher bench.
position yourself so that your ankles are under the pads.
You should be upright and maintaining good posture.

sumo-deadlift-2.name: Sumo Deadlift
cues: Begin with a bar loaded on the ground.
Approach the bar so that the bar intersects the middle of the feet.
The feet should be set very wide, near the collars.
Bend at the hips to grip the bar.

kettlebell-seated-press-2.name: Kettlebell Seated Press
cues: Sit on the floor and spread your legs out comfortably.

narrow-stance-leg-press-2.name: Narrow Stance Leg Press
cues: Using a leg press machine.
sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a less-than-shoulder-width narrow stance with the toes slightly pointed out.
Your feet should be around 3 inches or less apart.
Tip: Keep your head up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times.

one-arm-open-palm-kettlebell-clean-2.name: One-Arm Open Palm Kettlebell Clean
cues: Place one kettlebell between your feet.

leg-up-hamstring-stretch-2.name: Leg-Up Hamstring Stretch
cues: Lie flat on your back, bend one knee, and put that foot flat on the floor to stabilize your spine.

preacher-curl-2.name: Preacher Curl
cues: To perform this movement you will need a preacher bench and an E-Z bar.
Grab the E-Z curl bar at the close inner handle (either have someone hand you the bar which is preferable or grab the bar from the front bar rest provided by most preacher benches).
The palm of your hands should be facing forward and they should be slightly tilted inwards due to the shape of the bar.

smith-incline-shoulder-raise-2.name: Smith Incline Shoulder Raise
cues: Place an incline bench underneath the smith machine.
Place the barbell at a height that you can reach when lying down and your arms are almost fully extended.
Once the weight you need is selected.
lie down on the incline bench and make sure your shoulders are aligned right under the barbell.

butt-ups-2.name: Butt-Ups
cues: Begin a pushup position but with your elbows on the ground and resting on your forearms.
Your arms should be bent at a 90 degree angle.

rack-pull-with-bands-2.name: Rack Pull with Bands
cues: Set up in a power rack with the bar on the pins.
The pins should be set to the desired point.
just below the knees.
Attach bands to the base of the rack, or secure them with dumbbells.

wrist-rotations-with-straight-bar-2.name: Wrist Rotations with Straight Bar
cues: Hold a barbell with both hands and your palms facing down; hands spaced about shoulder width.
This will be your starting position.

wrist-circles-2.name: Wrist Circles
cues: Start by standing straight with your feet being shoulder width apart from each other.
Elevate your arms to the side of you until they are fully extended and parallel to the floor at a height that is evenly aligned with your shoulders.
Tip: Your torso and arms should form the letter "T: Your palms should be facing down.
This is the starting position.

zottman-curl-2.name: Zottman Curl
cues: Stand up with your torso upright and a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length.
The elbows should be close to the torso.

alternating-floor-press-2.name: Alternating Floor Press
cues: Lie on the floor with two kettlebells next to your shoulders.

single-leg-leg-extension-2.name: Single-Leg Leg Extension
cues: Seat yourself in the machine and adjust it so that you are positioned properly.
The pad should be against the lower part of the shin but not in contact with the ankle.
Adjust the seat so that the pivot point is in line with your knee.
Select a weight appropriate for your abilities.

leverage-shoulder-press-2.name: Leverage Shoulder Press
cues: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height.
The handles should be near the top of the shoulders at the beginning of the motion.
Your chest and head should be up and handles held with a pronated grip.
This will be your starting position.

push-ups-with-feet-on-an-exercise-ball-2.name: Push-Ups With Feet On An Exercise Ball
cues: Lie on the floor face down and place your hands about 36 inches apart from each other holding your torso up at arms length.

dancers-stretch-2.name: Dancer's Stretch
cues: Sit up on the floor.

split-squat-with-dumbbells-2.name: Split Squat with Dumbbells
cues: Position yourself into a staggered stance with the rear foot elevated and front foot forward.

lying-triceps-press-2.name: Lying Triceps Press
cues: Lie on a flat bench with either an e-z bar (my preference) or a straight bar placed on the floor behind your head and your feet on the floor.

cable-internal-rotation-2.name: Cable Internal Rotation
cues: Sit next to a low pulley sideways (with legs stretched in front of you or crossed) and grasp the single hand cable attachment with the arm nearest to the cable.
Tip: If you can adjust the pulley's height, you can use a flat bench to sit on instead.

seated-good-mornings-2.name: Seated Good Mornings
cues: Set up a box in a power rack.
The pins should be set at an appropriate height.
Begin by stepping under the bar and placing it across the back of the shoulders.
not on top of your traps.

standing-barbell-press-behind-neck-2.name: Standing Barbell Press Behind Neck
cues: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for easier pick up of the bar.
To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height.
Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded.
step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it.

smith-machine-bent-over-row-2.name: Smith Machine Bent Over Row
cues: Set the barbell attached to the smith machine to a height that is about 2 inches below your knees.

palms-down-wrist-curl-over-a-bench-2.name: Palms-Down Wrist Curl Over A Bench
cues: Start out by placing a barbell on one side of a flat bench.

hyperextensions-with-no-hyperextension-b.name: Hyperextensions With No Hyperextension Bench
cues: With someone holding down your legs.
slide yourself down to the edge a flat bench until your hips hang off the end of the bench.
Tip: Your entire upper body should be hanging down towards the floor.
Also.

reverse-triceps-bench-press-2.name: Reverse Triceps Bench Press
cues: Lie back on a flat bench.
Using a close.
supinated grip (around shoulder width).
This will be your starting position.

close-grip-ez-bar-curl-2.name: Close-Grip EZ Bar Curl
cues: Stand up with your torso upright while holding an E-Z Curl Bar at the closer inner handle.
The palm of your hands should be facing forward and they should be slightly tilted inwards due to the shape of the bar.
The elbows should be close to the torso.
This will be your starting position.

iliotibial-tract-smr-2.name: Iliotibial Tract-SMR
cues: Lay on your side, with the bottom leg placed onto a foam roller between the hip and the knee.
The other leg can be crossed in front of you.

smith-machine-reverse-calf-raises-2.name: Smith Machine Reverse Calf Raises
cues: Adjust the barbell on the smith machine to fit your height and align a raised platform right under the bar.

seated-triceps-press-2.name: Seated Triceps Press
cues: Sit down on a bench with back support and grasp a dumbbell with both hands and hold it overhead at arm's length.
Tip: a better way is to have somebody hand it to you especially if it is very heavy.
The resistance should be resting in the palms of your hands with your thumbs around it.
The palm of the hand should be facing inward.

mixed-grip-chin-2.name: Mixed Grip Chin
cues: Using a spacing that is just about 1 inch wider than shoulder width.
grab a pull-up bar with the palms of one hand facing forward and the palms of the other hand facing towards you.
This will be your starting position.

leg-lift-2.name: Leg Lift
cues: While standing up straight with both feet next to each other at around shoulder width.
grab a sturdy surface such as the sides of a squat rack or the top of a chair to brace yourself and keep balance.

peroneals-stretch-2.name: Peroneals Stretch
cues: In a seated position, loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot.
This will be your starting position.

single-cone-sprint-drill-2.name: Single-Cone Sprint Drill
cues: This drill teaches quick foot action.
You need a single cone.
Begin standing next to the cone with one arm back and one arm forward.

lying-close-grip-bar-curl-on-high-pulley.name: Lying Close-Grip Bar Curl On High Pulley
cues: Place a flat bench in front of a high pulley or lat pulldown machine.

standing-elevated-quad-stretch-2.name: Standing Elevated Quad Stretch
cues: Start by standing with your back about two to three feet away from a bench or step.

balance-board-2.name: Balance Board
cues: Place a balance board in front of you.

isometric-wipers-2.name: Isometric Wipers
cues: Assume a push-up position.
supporting your weight on your hands and toes while keeping your body straight.
Your hands should be just outside of shoulder width.
This will be your starting position.

reverse-barbell-preacher-curls-2.name: Reverse Barbell Preacher Curls
cues: Grab an EZ-bar using a shoulder width and palms down (pronated) grip.

dumbbell-lying-pronation-2.name: Dumbbell Lying Pronation
cues: Lie on a flat bench face down with one arm holding a dumbbell and the other hand on top of the bench folded so that you can rest your head on it.

cable-rope-overhead-triceps-extension-2.name: Cable Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
cues: Attach a rope to the bottom pulley of the pulley machine.

glute-kickback-2.name: Glute Kickback
cues: Kneel on the floor or an exercise mat and bend at the waist with your arms extended in front of you (perpendicular to the torso) in order to get into a kneeling push-up position but with the arms spaced at shoulder width.
Your head should be looking forward and the bend of the knees should create a 90-degree angle between the hamstrings and the calves.
This will be your starting position.

weighted-squat-2.name: Weighted Squat
cues: Start by positioning two flat benches shoulder width apart from each other.
Stand on top of them and wrap the weighted belt around your waist with the amount of weight you feel comfortable with.
Make sure your toes are facing out.

crunches-2.name: Crunches
cues: Lie flat on your back with your feet flat on the ground.
or resting on a bench with your knees bent at a 90 degree angle.
If you are resting your feet on a bench.
place them three to four inches apart and point your toes inward so they touch.

one-arm-chin-up-2.name: One Arm Chin-Up
cues: For this exercise, start out by placing a towel around a chin up bar.

weighted-sit-ups-with-bands-2.name: Weighted Sit-Ups - With Bands
cues: Start out by strapping the bands around the base of the decline bench.
Place the handles towards the inside of the decline bench so that when lying down.
you can reach for both of them.

smith-machine-bench-press-2.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
cues: Place a flat bench underneath the smith machine.
Now place the barbell at a height that you can reach when lying down and your arms are almost fully extended.
Once the weight you need is selected, lie down on the flat bench.
Using a pronated grip that is wider than shoulder width.

single-dumbbell-raise-2.name: Single Dumbbell Raise
cues: With a wide stance.
hold a dumbell with both hands.
Your arms should be extended and hanging at the waist.
This will be your starting position.

bent-over-two-dumbbell-row-with-palms-in.name: Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row With Palms In
cues: With a dumbbell in each hand (palms facing each other).
bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward.
Tip: Make sure that you keep the head up.
The weights should hang directly in front of you as your arms hang perpendicular to the floor and your torso.

barbell-bench-press-medium-grip-2.name: Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip
cues: Lie back on a flat bench.
Using a medium width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms).
lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked.
This will be your starting position.

one-arm-medicine-ball-slam-2.name: One-Arm Medicine Ball Slam
cues: Start in a standing position with a staggered, athletic stance.
Hold a medicine ball in one hand, on the same side as your back leg.
This will be your starting position.

frog-sit-ups-2.name: Frog Sit-Ups
cues: Lie with your back flat on the floor (or exercise mat) and your legs extended in front of you.

one-arm-floor-press-2.name: One Arm Floor Press
cues: Lie down on a flat surface with your back pressing against the floor or an exercise mat.
Make sure your knees are bent.

tire-flip-2.name: Tire Flip
cues: Begin by gripping the bottom of the tire on the tread, and position your feet back a bit.
Your chest should be driving into the tire.

decline-barbell-bench-press-2.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
cues: Secure your legs at the end of the decline bench and slowly lay down on the bench.

axle-deadlift-2.name: Axle Deadlift
cues: Approach the bar so that it is centered over your feet.
You feet should be about hip width apart.
Bend at the hip to grip the bar at shoulder width, allowing your shoulder blades to protract.
Typically, you would use an over/under grip.

standing-dumbbell-press-2.name: Standing Dumbbell Press
cues: Standing with your feet shoulder width apart, take a dumbbell in each hand.
Raise the dumbbells to head height, the elbows out and about 90 degrees.
This will be your starting position.

incline-hammer-curls-2.name: Incline Hammer Curls
cues: Seat yourself on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
You should pressed firmly against he back with your feet together.
Allow the dumbbells to hang straight down at your side, holding them with a neutral grip.
This will be your starting position.

push-up-wide-2.name: Push-Up Wide
cues: With your hands wide apart, support your body on your toes and hands in a plank position.
Your elbows should be extended and your body straight.
Do not allow your hips to sag.
This will be your starting position.

reverse-band-box-squat-2.name: Reverse Band Box Squat
cues: Begin in a power rack with a box at the appropriate height behind you.
Set up the bands either on band pegs or attached to the top of the rack.
ensuring they will be directly above the bar during the squat.
Attach the other end to the bar.

barbell-lunge-2.name: Barbell Lunge
cues: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes.
To begin, first set the bar on a rack just below shoulder level.
Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded.
step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it.

looking-at-ceiling-2.name: Looking At Ceiling
cues: Kneel on the floor, holding your heels with both hands.

bench-jump-2.name: Bench Jump
cues: Begin with a box or bench 1-2 feet in front of you.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
This will be your starting position.

speed-box-squat-2.name: Speed Box Squat
cues: Attach bands to the bar that are securely anchored near the ground.
You may need to choke the bands to get adequate tension.

seated-dumbbell-press-2.name: Seated Dumbbell Press
cues: Grab a couple of dumbbells and sit on a military press bench or a utility bench that has a back support on it as you place the dumbbells upright on top of your thighs.

dumbbell-shoulder-press-2.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cues: While holding a dumbbell in each hand.
sit on a military press bench or utility bench that has back support.
Place the dumbbells upright on top of your thighs.

decline-dumbbell-triceps-extension-2.name: Decline Dumbbell Triceps Extension
cues: Secure your legs at the end of the decline bench and lie down with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs.
The palms of your hand will be facing each other.

box-squat-with-bands-2.name: Box Squat with Bands
cues: Begin in a power rack with a box at the appropriate height behind you.
Set up the bands on the sleeves.
secured to either band pegs.
If dumbbells are used, secure them so that they don't move.

hanging-bar-good-morning-2.name: Hanging Bar Good Morning
cues: Begin with a bar on a rack at about the same height as your stomach.
Suspend the bar using chains or suspension straps.

side-lying-groin-stretch-2.name: Side Lying Groin Stretch
cues: Start off by lying on your right side and bend your right knee in front of you to stabilize the torso.

clock-push-up-2.name: Clock Push-Up
cues: Move into a prone position on the floor, supporting your weight on your hands and toes.

wide-grip-standing-barbell-curl-2.name: Wide-Grip Standing Barbell Curl
cues: Stand up with your torso upright while holding a barbell at the wide outer handle.
The palm of your hands should be facing forward.
The elbows should be close to the torso.
This will be your starting position.

side-laterals-to-front-raise-2.name: Side Laterals to Front Raise
cues: In a standing position, hold a pair of dumbbells at your side.
This will be your starting position.

dumbbell-one-arm-shoulder-press-2.name: Dumbbell One-Arm Shoulder Press
cues: Grab a dumbbell and either sit on a military press bench or a utility bench that has a back support on it as you place the dumbbells upright on top of your thighs or stand up straight.

seated-one-arm-cable-pulley-rows-2.name: Seated One-arm Cable Pulley Rows
cues: To get into the starting position.
first sit down on the machine and place your feet on the front platform or crossbar provided making sure that your knees are slightly bent and not locked.

lateral-cone-hops-2.name: Lateral Cone Hops
cues: Position a number of cones in a row several feet apart.

standing-gastrocnemius-calf-stretch-2.name: Standing Gastrocnemius Calf Stretch
cues: Place your right heel on a step with your knee extended and lean forward to grab your right toe with your right hand.
Your left knee should be slightly bent and your back should be straight.

bent-over-dumbbell-rear-delt-raise-with-.name: Bent Over Dumbbell Rear Delt Raise With Head On Bench
cues: Stand up straight while holding a dumbbell in each hand and with an incline bench in front of you.

romanian-deadlift-3.name: Romanian Deadlift
cues: Put a barbell in front of you on the ground and grab it using a pronated (palms facing down) grip that a little wider than shoulder width.
Tip: Depending on the weight used.
you may need wrist wraps to perform the exercise and also a raised platform in order to allow for better range of motion.

narrow-stance-hack-squats-2.name: Narrow Stance Hack Squats
cues: Place the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook your shoulders under the shoulder pads provided.

standing-bent-over-one-arm-dumbbell-tric.name: Standing Bent-Over One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
cues: With a dumbbell in one hand and the palm facing your torso.
bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward.
Make sure that you keep the head up.

shoulder-raise-2.name: Shoulder Raise
cues: Relax your arms to your sides and raise your shoulders up toward your ears, then back down.

wide-stance-barbell-squat-2.name: Wide Stance Barbell Squat
cues: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes.
To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height.
Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded.
step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it.

isometric-chest-squeezes-2.name: Isometric Chest Squeezes
cues: While either seating or standing.
bend your arms at a 90-degree angle and place the palms of your hands together in front of your chest.
Tip: Your hands should be open with the palms together and fingers facing forward (perpendicular to your torso).

reverse-barbell-curl-2.name: Reverse Barbell Curl
cues: Stand up with your torso upright while holding a barbell at shoulder width with the elbows close to the torso.
The palm of your hands should be facing down (pronated grip).
This will be your starting position.

standing-two-arm-overhead-throw-2.name: Standing Two-Arm Overhead Throw
cues: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding a medicine ball in both hands.
To begin, reach the medicine ball deep behind your head as you bend the knees slightly and lean back.

sled-row-2.name: Sled Row
cues: Attach dual handles to a sled connected by a rope or chain.
Load the sled to an appropriate weight.
Face the sled, backing up until there is some tension in the line.

two-arm-kettlebell-military-press-2.name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Military Press
cues: Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders.
Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you swing the kettlebells towards your shoulders.
Rotate your wrists as you do so, so that the palms face forward.

incline-push-up-medium-2.name: Incline Push-Up Medium
cues: Stand facing a Smith machine bar or sturdy elevated platform at an appropriate height.

one-arm-kettlebell-floor-press-2.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Floor Press
cues: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell with one hand, with your upper arm supported by the floor.
The palm should be facing in.

lying-face-up-plate-neck-resistance-2.name: Lying Face Up Plate Neck Resistance
cues: Lie face up with your whole body straight on a flat bench while holding a weight plate on top of your forehead.
Tip: You will need to position yourself so that your shoulders are slightly above the end of a flat bench in order for the traps.
neck and head to be off the bench.
This will be your starting position.

band-hip-adductions-2.name: Band Hip Adductions
cues: Anchor a band around a solid post or other object.

two-arm-dumbbell-preacher-curl-2.name: Two-Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl
cues: Grab a dumbbell with each arm and place the upper arms on top of the preacher bench or the incline bench.
The dumbbell should be held at shoulder length.
This will be your starting position.

pushups-2.name: Pushups
cues: Lie on the floor face down and place your hands about 36 inches apart while holding your torso up at arms length.

adductor-2.name: Adductor
cues: Lie face down with one leg on a foam roll.

double-kettlebell-alternating-hang-clean.name: Double Kettlebell Alternating Hang Clean
cues: Place two kettlebells between your feet.
To get in the starting position, push your butt back and look straight ahead.

weighted-crunches-2.name: Weighted Crunches
cues: Lie flat on your back with your feet flat on the ground or resting on a bench with your knees bent at a 90 degree angle.

seated-dumbbell-inner-biceps-curl-2.name: Seated Dumbbell Inner Biceps Curl
cues: Sit on the end of a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length.
The elbows should be close to the torso.

bear-crawl-sled-drags-2.name: Bear Crawl Sled Drags
cues: Wearing either a harness or a loose weight belt.
attach the chain to the back so that you will be facing away from the sled.
Bend down so that your hands are on the ground.
Your back should be flat and knees bent.

inverted-row-with-straps-2.name: Inverted Row with Straps
cues: Hang a rope or suspension straps from a rack or other stable object.
Grasp the ends and position yourself in a supine position hanging from the ropes.
Your body should be straight with your heels on the ground with your arms fully extended.
This will be your starting position.

standing-lateral-stretch-2.name: Standing Lateral Stretch
cues: Take a slightly wider than hip distance stance with your knees slightly bent.

decline-reverse-crunch-2.name: Decline Reverse Crunch
cues: Lie on your back on a decline bench and hold on to the top of the bench with both hands.
Don't let your body slip down from this position.

single-arm-cable-crossover-2.name: Single-Arm Cable Crossover
cues: Begin by moving the pulleys to the high position.
select the resistance to be used.

one-arm-kettlebell-para-press-2.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Para Press
cues: Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder.
Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder.
Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward.
This will be your starting position.

triceps-pushdown-rope-attachment-2.name: Triceps Pushdown - Rope Attachment
cues: Attach a rope attachment to a high pulley and grab with a neutral grip (palms facing each other).

leverage-iso-row-2.name: Leverage Iso Row
cues: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat height so that the handles are at chest level.
Grasp the handles with either a neutral or pronated grip.
This will be your starting position.

carioca-quick-step-2.name: Carioca Quick Step
cues: Begin with your feet a few inches apart and your left arm up in a relaxed, athletic position.

shotgun-row-2.name: Shotgun Row
cues: Attach a single handle to a low cable.

lateral-bound-2.name: Lateral Bound
cues: Assume a half squat position facing 90 degrees from your direction of travel.
This will be your starting position.

lower-back-smr-2.name: Lower Back-SMR
cues: In a seated position, place a foam roll under your lower back.
Cross your arms in front of you and protract your shoulders.
This will be your starting position.

snatch-2.name: Snatch
cues: Place your feet at a shoulder width stance with the barbell resting right above the connection between the toes and the rest of the foot.

jefferson-squats-2.name: Jefferson Squats
cues: Place a barbell on the floor.

dead-bug-2.name: Dead Bug
cues: Begin lying on your back with your hands extended above you toward the ceiling.

dumbbell-shrug-2.name: Dumbbell Shrug
cues: Stand erect with a dumbbell on each hand (palms facing your torso), arms extended on the sides.

intermediate-groin-stretch-2.name: Intermediate Groin Stretch
cues: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Loop a belt, rope, or band around one of your feet, and swing that leg as far to the side as you can.
This will be your starting position.

crunch-legs-on-exercise-ball-2.name: Crunch - Legs On Exercise Ball
cues: Lie flat on your back with your feet resting on an exercise ball and your knees bent at a 90 degree angle.

standing-leg-curl-2.name: Standing Leg Curl
cues: Adjust the machine lever to fit your height and lie with your torso bent at the waist facing forward around 30-45 degrees (since an angled position is more favorable for hamstrings recruitment) with the pad of the lever on the back of your right leg (just a few inches under the calves) and the front of the right leg on top of the machine pad.

seated-calf-raise-2.name: Seated Calf Raise
cues: Sit on the machine and place your toes on the lower portion of the platform provided with the heels extending off.
Choose the toe positioning of your choice (forward, in, or out) as per the beginning of this chapter.

stairmaster-2.name: Stairmaster
cues: To begin, step onto the stairmaster and select the desired option from the menu.
You can choose a manual setting, or you can select a program to run.
Typically.
you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise.

star-jump-2.name: Star Jump
cues: Begin in a relaxed stance with your feet shoulder width apart and hold your arms close to the body.

chin-to-chest-stretch-2.name: Chin To Chest Stretch
cues: Get into a seated position on the floor.

close-grip-ez-bar-press-2.name: Close-Grip EZ-Bar Press
cues: Lie on a flat bench with an EZ bar loaded to an appropriate weight.

kneeling-cable-triceps-extension-2.name: Kneeling Cable Triceps Extension
cues: Place a bench sideways in front of a high pulley machine.

seated-hamstring-and-calf-stretch-2.name: Seated Hamstring and Calf Stretch
cues: Loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot.
Sit down with both legs extended.
This will be your starting position.

step-mill-2.name: Step Mill
cues: To begin, step onto the stepmill and select the desired option from the menu.
You can choose a manual setting, or you can select a program to run.
Typically.
you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise.

straight-bar-bench-mid-rows-2.name: Straight Bar Bench Mid Rows
cues: Place a loaded barbell on the end of a bench.
Standing on the bench behind the bar, take a medium, pronated grip.
Stand with your hips back and chest up, maintaining a neutral spine.
This will be your starting position.

smith-machine-behind-the-back-shrug-2.name: Smith Machine Behind the Back Shrug
cues: With the bar at thigh level, load an appropriate weight.

standing-alternating-dumbbell-press-2.name: Standing Alternating Dumbbell Press
cues: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand.
Raise the dumbbells to your shoulders with your palms facing forward and your elbows pointed out.
This will be your starting position.

low-cable-crossover-2.name: Low Cable Crossover
cues: To move into the starting position.
place the pulleys at the low position.

v-bar-pulldown-2.name: V-Bar Pulldown

cues: Set up a row of cones or other small barriers, placing them a few feet apart.

weighted-bench-dip-2.name: Weighted Bench Dip
cues: For this exercise you will need to place a bench behind your back and another one in front of you.
With the benches perpendicular to your body.
hold on to one bench on its edge with the hands close to your body.
Your arms should be fully extended.

barbell-ab-rollout-on-knees-2.name: Barbell Ab Rollout - On Knees
cues: Hold an Olympic barbell loaded with 5-10lbs on each side and kneel on the floor.

all-fours-quad-stretch-2.name: All Fours Quad Stretch
cues: Start off on your hands and knees, then lift your leg off the floor and hold the foot with your hand.

lying-dumbbell-tricep-extension-2.name: Lying Dumbbell Tricep Extension
cues: Lie on a flat bench while holding two dumbbells directly in front of you.
Your arms should be fully extended at a 90-degree angle from your torso and the floor.
The palms should be facing in and the elbows should be tucked in.
This is the starting position.

single-arm-linear-jammer-2.name: Single-Arm Linear Jammer
cues: Position a bar into a landmine or securely anchor it in a corner.
Load the bar to an appropriate weight.

front-barbell-squat-to-a-bench-2.name: Front Barbell Squat To A Bench
cues: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes.
To begin, first set a flat bench behind you and set the bar on a rack that best matches your height.
Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded.
bring your arms up under the bar while keeping the elbows high and the upper arm slightly above parallel to the floor.

zercher-squats-2.name: Zercher Squats
cues: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes.
To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height.
The correct height should be anywhere above the waist but below the chest.
Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded.

one-legged-cable-kickback-2.name: One-Legged Cable Kickback
cues: Hook a leather ankle cuff to a low cable pulley and then attach the cuff to your ankle.

circus-bell-2.name: Circus Bell
cues: The circus bell is an oversized dumbbell with a thick handle.
Begin with the dumbbell between your feet, and grip the handle with both hands.

seated-dumbbell-palms-up-wrist-curl-2.name: Seated Dumbbell Palms-Up Wrist Curl
cues: Start out by placing two dumbbells on the floor in front of a flat bench.

internal-rotation-with-band-2.name: Internal Rotation with Band
cues: Choke the band around a post.
The band should be at the same height as your elbow.
Stand with your right side to the band a couple of feet away.

seated-band-hamstring-curl-2.name: Seated Band Hamstring Curl
cues: Secure a band close to the ground and place a bench a couple feet away from it.

smith-machine-hip-raise-2.name: Smith Machine Hip Raise
cues: Position a bench in the rack and load the bar to an appropriate weight.
Lie down on the bench, placing the bottom of your feet against the bar.
Unlock the bar and extend your legs.
You may need to use your hands to assist you.

cable-judo-flip-2.name: Cable Judo Flip
cues: Connect a rope attachment to a tower, and move the cable to the lowest pulley position.
Stand with your side to the cable with a wide stance, and grab the rope with both hands.

barbell-full-squat-2.name: Barbell Full Squat
cues: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes.
To begin, first set the bar on a rack just above shoulder level.
Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded.
step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it.

standing-dumbbell-straight-arm-front-del.name: Standing Dumbbell Straight-Arm Front Delt Raise Above Head
cues: Hold the dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing your thighs.

gironda-sternum-chins-2.name: Gironda Sternum Chins
cues: Grasp the pull-up bar with a shoulder width underhand grip.

rickshaw-deadlift-2.name: Rickshaw Deadlift
cues: Load the frame with the desired weight.
Center yourself between the handles.
You feet should be about hip width apart.
Bend at the hips to grip the handles, allowing your shoulder blades to protract.

one-arm-dumbbell-bench-press-2.name: One Arm Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand on top of your thigh.

farmers-walk-2.name: Farmer's Walk
cues: There are various implements that can be used for the farmers walk.
These can also be performed with heavy dumbbells or short bars if these implements aren't available.
Begin by standing between the implements.

seated-glute-2.name: Seated Glute
cues: In a seated position with your knees bent, cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Your partner will stand behind you.
Now, lean forward as your partner braces your shoulders with their hands.
This will be your starting position.

dips-triceps-version-2.name: Dips - Triceps Version
cues: To get into the starting position.
hold your body at arm's length with your arms nearly locked above the bars.

one-arm-kettlebell-clean-and-jerk-2.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Clean and Jerk
cues: Hold a kettlebell by the handle.

alternate-heel-touchers-2.name: Alternate Heel Touchers
cues: Lie on the floor with the knees bent and the feet on the floor around 18-24 inches apart.
Your arms should be extended by your side.
This will be your starting position.

chest-push-single-response-2.name: Chest Push (single response)
cues: Begin in a kneeling position holding the medicine ball with both hands tightly into the chest.

decline-oblique-crunch-2.name: Decline Oblique Crunch
cues: Secure your legs at the end of the decline bench and slowly lay down on the bench.

inchworm-2.name: Inchworm
cues: Stand with your feet close together.
Keeping your legs straight, stretch down and put your hands on the floor directly in front of you.
This will be your starting position.

lying-supine-dumbbell-curl-2.name: Lying Supine Dumbbell Curl
cues: Lie down on a flat bench face up while holding a dumbbell in each arm on top of your thighs.

cable-shoulder-press-2.name: Cable Shoulder Press
cues: Move the cables to the bottom of the towers and select an appropriate weight.

running-treadmill-2.name: Running, Treadmill
cues: To begin, step onto the treadmill and select the desired option from the menu.
Most treadmills have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run.
Typically.
you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise.

wind-sprints-2.name: Wind Sprints
cues: Hang from a pull-up bar using a pronated grip.
Your arms and legs should be extended.
This will be your starting position.

external-rotation-2.name: External Rotation
cues: Lie sideways on a flat bench with one arm holding a dumbbell and the other hand on top of the bench folded so that you can rest your head on it.

elbow-circles-2.name: Elbow Circles
cues: Sit or stand with your feet slightly apart.

clean-deadlift-2.name: Clean Deadlift
cues: Begin standing with a barbell close to your shins.
Your feet should be directly under your hips with your feet turned out slightly.
Grip the bar with a double overhand grip or hook grip, about shoulder width apart.
Squat down to the bar.

close-grip-push-up-off-of-a-dumbbell-2.name: Close-Grip Push-Up off of a Dumbbell
cues: Lie on the floor and place your hands on an upright dumbbell.
Supporting your weight on your toes and hands.
keep your torso rigid and your elbows in with your arms straight.
This will be your starting position.

cable-hip-adduction-2.name: Cable Hip Adduction
cues: Stand in front of a low pulley facing forward with one leg next to the pulley and the other one away.

dumbbell-lying-one-arm-rear-lateral-rais.name: Dumbbell Lying One-Arm Rear Lateral Raise
cues: While holding a dumbbell in one hand.
lay with your chest down on a slightly inclined (around 15 degrees when measured from the floor) adjustable bench.
The other hand can be used to hold to the leg of the bench for stability.

pin-presses-2.name: Pin Presses
cues: Pin presses remove the eccentric phase of the bench press, developing starting strength.
They also allow you to train a desired range of motion.

frankenstein-squat-2.name: Frankenstein Squat
cues: This drill teaches you the proper positioning of both the bar and your body during the clean and front squat.

zottman-preacher-curl-2.name: Zottman Preacher Curl
cues: Grab a dumbbell in each hand and place your upper arms on top of the preacher bench or the incline bench.
The dumbbells should be held at shoulder height and the elbows should be flexed.
Hold the dumbbells with the palms of your hands facing down.
This will be your starting position.

dumbbell-step-ups-2.name: Dumbbell Step Ups
cues: Stand up straight while holding a dumbbell on each hand (palms facing the side of your legs).

body-tricep-press-2.name: Body Tricep Press
cues: Position a bar in a rack at chest height.

plie-dumbbell-squat-2.name: Plie Dumbbell Squat
cues: Hold a dumbbell at the base with both hands and stand straight up.
Move your legs so that they are wider than shoulder width apart from each other with your knees slightly bent.

standing-rope-crunch-2.name: Standing Rope Crunch
cues: Attach a rope to a high pulley and select an appropriate weight.

hip-flexion-with-band-2.name: Hip Flexion with Band
cues: Secure one end of the band to the lower portion of a post and attach the other to one ankle.

reverse-band-deadlift-2.name: Reverse Band Deadlift
cues: Set the bar up in a power rack.
Attach bands to the top of the rack, using either bands pegs or the frame itself.
Attach the other end of the bands to the bar.

conans-wheel-2.name: Conan's Wheel
cues: With the weight loaded, take a zurcher hold on the end of the implement.
Place the bar in the crook of the elbow and hold onto your wrist.
Try to keep the weight off of the forearms.

bent-over-two-dumbbell-row-2.name: Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row
cues: With a dumbbell in each hand (palms facing your torso).
bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward by bending at the waist.
Tip: Make sure that you keep the head up.
The weights should hang directly in front of you as your arms hang perpendicular to the floor and your torso.

pallof-press-with-rotation-2.name: Pallof Press With Rotation
cues: Connect a standard handle to a tower, and position the cable to shoulder height.

standing-front-barbell-raise-over-head-2.name: Standing Front Barbell Raise Over Head
cues: To begin, stand straight with a barbell in your hands.
You should grip the bar with palms facing down and a closer than shoulder width grip apart from each other.

one-arm-kettlebell-split-jerk-2.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Split Jerk
cues: Hold a kettlebell by the handle.
Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder.
Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward.
This will be your starting position.

overhead-stretch-2.name: Overhead Stretch
cues: Standing straight up, lace your fingers together and open your palms to the ceiling.
Keep your shoulders down as you extend your arms up.

lying-crossover-2.name: Lying Crossover
cues: Lie on your back with your legs extended.

cable-reverse-crunch-2.name: Cable Reverse Crunch
cues: Connect an ankle strap attachment to a low pulley cable and position a mat on the floor in front of it.

calf-machine-shoulder-shrug-2.name: Calf-Machine Shoulder Shrug
cues: Position yourself on the calf machine so that the shoulder pads are above your shoulders.
Your torso should be straight with the arms extended normally by your side.
This will be your starting position.

oblique-crunches-2.name: Oblique Crunches
cues: Lie flat on the floor with your lower back pressed to the ground.
For this exercise.
you will need to put one hand beside your head and the other to the side against the floor.

seated-two-arm-palms-up-low-pulley-wrist.name: Seated Two-Arm Palms-Up Low-Pulley Wrist Curl
cues: Put a bench in front of a low pulley machine that has a barbell or EZ Curl attachment on it.

overhead-cable-curl-2.name: Overhead Cable Curl
cues: To begin, set a weight that is comfortable on each side of the pulley machine.
Note: Make sure that the amount of weight selected is the same on each side.

two-arm-kettlebell-clean-2.name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Clean
cues: Place two kettlebells between your feet.
To get in the starting position, push your butt back and look straight ahead.

rocking-standing-calf-raise-2.name: Rocking Standing Calf Raise
cues: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes.
To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height.
Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded.
step under the bar and place it on the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck).

front-plate-raise-2.name: Front Plate Raise
cues: While standing straight, hold a barbell plate in both hands at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions.
Your palms should be facing each other and your arms should be extended and locked with a slight bend at the elbows and the plate should be down near your waist in front of you as far as you can go.
Tip: The arms will remain in this position throughout the exercise.
This will be your starting position.

quadriceps-smr-2.name: Quadriceps-SMR
cues: Lay facedown on the floor with your weight supported by your hands or forearms.
Place a foam roll underneath one leg on the quadriceps, and keep the foot off of the ground.
Make sure to relax the leg as much as possible.
This will be your starting position.

dumbbell-squat-2.name: Dumbbell Squat
cues: Stand up straight while holding a dumbbell on each hand (palms facing the side of your legs).

low-cable-triceps-extension-2.name: Low Cable Triceps Extension
cues: Select the desired weight and lay down face up on the bench of a seated row machine that has a rope attached to it.
Your head should be pointing towards the attachment.

standing-one-arm-dumbbell-curl-over-incl.name: Standing One-Arm Dumbbell Curl Over Incline Bench
cues: Stand on the back side of an incline bench as if you were going to be a spotter for someone.
Have a dumbbell in one hand and rest it across the incline bench with a supinated (palms up) grip.

snatch-balance-2.name: Snatch Balance
cues: Begin with the feet in the pulling position.
the bar racked across the back of the shoulders.

concentration-curls-2.name: Concentration Curls
cues: Sit down on a flat bench with one dumbbell in front of you between your legs.
Your legs should be spread with your knees bent and feet on the floor.

standing-soleus-and-achilles-stretch-2.name: Standing Soleus And Achilles Stretch
cues: Stand with your feet hip-distance apart, one foot slightly in front of the other.

cable-crossover-2.name: Cable Crossover
cues: To get yourself into the starting position.
place the pulleys on a high position (above your head).

barbell-hack-squat-2.name: Barbell Hack Squat
cues: Stand up straight while holding a barbell behind you at arms length and your feet at shoulder width.
Tip: A shoulder width grip is best with the palms of your hands facing back.
You can use wrist wraps for this exercise for a better grip.
This will be your starting position.

front-leg-raises-2.name: Front Leg Raises
cues: Stand next to a chair or other support, holding on with one hand.

spinal-stretch-2.name: Spinal Stretch
cues: Sit in a chair so your back is straight and your feet planted on the floor.

front-two-dumbbell-raise-2.name: Front Two-Dumbbell Raise
cues: Pick a couple of dumbbells and stand with a straight torso and the dumbbells on front of your thighs at arms length with the palms of the hand facing your thighs.
This will be your starting position.

band-skull-crusher-2.name: Band Skull Crusher
cues: Secure a band to the base of a rack or the bench.
Lay on the bench so that the band is lined up with your head.

pushups-close-and-wide-hand-positions-2.name: Pushups (Close and Wide Hand Positions)
cues: Lie on the floor face down and body straight with your toes on the floor and the hands wider than shoulder width for a wide hand position and closer than shoulder width for a close hand position.
Make sure you are holding your torso up at arms length.

cable-preacher-curl-2.name: Cable Preacher Curl
cues: Place a preacher bench about 2 feet in front of a pulley machine.

cable-russian-twists-2.name: Cable Russian Twists
cues: Connect a standard handle attachment, and position the cable to a middle pulley position.

leg-pull-in-2.name: Leg Pull-In
cues: Lie on an exercise mat with your legs extended and your hands either palms facing down next to you or under your glutes.
Tip: My preference is with the hands next to me.
This will be your starting position.

kettlebell-thruster-2.name: Kettlebell Thruster
cues: Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders.
Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebells towards your shoulders.
Rotate your wrists as you do so.
This will be your starting position.

external-rotation-with-cable-2.name: External Rotation with Cable
cues: Adjust the cable to the same height as your elbow.
Stand with your left side to the band a couple of feet away.

power-jerk-2.name: Power Jerk
cues: Standing with the weight racked on the front of the shoulders, begin with the dip.
With your feet directly under your hips, flex the knees without moving the hips backward.
Go down only slightly, and reverse direction as powerfully as possible.

upper-back-leg-grab-2.name: Upper Back-Leg Grab
cues: While seated, bend forward to hug your thighs from underneath with both arms.

calf-raise-on-a-dumbbell-2.name: Calf Raise On A Dumbbell
cues: Hang on to a sturdy object for balance and stand on a dumbbell handle.
preferably one with round plates so that it rolls as in this manner you have to work harder to stabilize yourself.

crunch-hands-overhead-2.name: Crunch - Hands Overhead
cues: Lie on the floor with your back flat and knees bent with around a 60-degree angle between the hamstrings and the calves.

lunge-pass-through-2.name: Lunge Pass Through
cues: Stand with your torso upright holding a kettlebell in your right hand.
This will be your starting position.

single-leg-hop-progression-2.name: Single-Leg Hop Progression
cues: Arrange a line of cones in front of you.
Assume a relaxed standing position, balanced on one leg.
Raise the knee of your opposite leg.
This will be your starting position.

lying-rear-delt-raise-2.name: Lying Rear Delt Raise
cues: While holding a dumbbell in each hand, lay with your chest down on a flat bench.

cross-over-with-bands-2.name: Cross Over - With Bands
cues: Secure an exercise band around a stationary post.

push-ups-with-feet-elevated-2.name: Push-Ups With Feet Elevated
cues: Lie on the floor face down and place your hands about 36 inches apart from each other holding your torso up at arms length.

dumbbell-one-arm-upright-row-2.name: Dumbbell One-Arm Upright Row
cues: Grab a dumbbell and stand up straight with your arm extended in front of you with a slight bend at the elbows and your back straight.
This will be your starting position.
Tip: The dumbbell should be resting on top of your thigh with the palm of your hands facing your thighs.

seated-cable-rows-2.name: Seated Cable Rows
cues: For this exercise you will need access to a low pulley row machine with a V-bar.
Note: The V-bar will enable you to have a neutral grip where the palms of your hands face each other.
To get into the starting position.
first sit down on the machine and place your feet on the front platform or crossbar provided making sure that your knees are slightly bent and not locked.

kettlebell-pistol-squat-2.name: Kettlebell Pistol Squat
cues: Pick up a kettlebell with two hands and hold it by the horns.
Hold one leg off of the floor and squat down on the other.

rope-climb-2.name: Rope Climb
cues: Grab the rope with both hands above your head.
Pull down on the rope as you take a small jump.

backward-medicine-ball-throw-2.name: Backward Medicine Ball Throw
cues: This exercise is best done with a partner.
If you lack a partner, the ball can be thrown and retrieved or thrown against a wall.

donkey-calf-raises-2.name: Donkey Calf Raises
cues: For this exercise you will need access to a donkey calf raise machine.
Start by positioning your lower back and hips under the padded lever provided.
The tailbone area should be the one making contact with the pad.

posterior-tibialis-stretch-2.name: Posterior Tibialis Stretch
cues: In a seated position, loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot.
This will be your starting position.

snatch-deadlift-2.name: Snatch Deadlift
cues: The snatch deadlift strengthens the first pull of the snatch.
Begin with a wide snatch grip with the barbell placed on the platform.
The feet should be directly under the hips, with the feet turned out.
Squat down to the bar, keeping the back in absolute extension with the head facing forward.

lateral-raise-with-bands-2.name: Lateral Raise - With Bands
cues: To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length.
Grasp the handles using a pronated (palms facing your thighs) grip that is slightly less than shoulder width.
The handles should be resting on the sides of your thighs.
Your arms should be extended with a slight bend at the elbows and your back should be straight.

standing-palm-in-one-arm-dumbbell-press-.name: Standing Palm-In One-Arm Dumbbell Press
cues: Start by having a dumbbell in one hand with your arm fully extended to the side using a neutral grip.
Use your other arm to hold on to an incline bench to keep your balance.

bent-knee-hip-raise-2.name: Bent-Knee Hip Raise
cues: Lay flat on the floor with your arms next to your sides.

spell-caster-2.name: Spell Caster
cues: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a pronated grip.
Your feet should be wide with your hips and knees extended.
This will be your starting position.

seated-biceps-2.name: Seated Biceps
cues: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your partner standing behind you.
Extend your arms straight behind you with your palms facing each other.
Your partner will hold your wrists for you.
This will be the starting position.

seated-leg-tucks-2.name: Seated Leg Tucks
cues: Sit on a bench with the legs stretched out in front of you slightly below parallel and your arms holding on to the sides of the bench.
Your torso should be leaning backwards around a 45-degree angle from the bench.
This will be your starting position.

one-arm-long-bar-row-2.name: One-Arm Long Bar Row
cues: Position a bar into a landmine or in a corner to keep it from moving.
Load an appropriate weight onto your end.

bicycling-stationary-2.name: Bicycling, Stationary
cues: To begin, seat yourself on the bike and adjust the seat to your height.

kneeling-forearm-stretch-2.name: Kneeling Forearm Stretch
cues: Start by kneeling on a mat with your palms flat and your fingers pointing back toward your knees.

london-bridges-2.name: London Bridges
cues: Attach a climbing rope to a high beam or cross member.
Below it, ensure that the smith machine bar is locked in place with the safeties and cannot move.
Alternatively, a secure box could also be utilized.

standing-palms-in-dumbbell-press-2.name: Standing Palms-In Dumbbell Press
cues: Start by having a dumbbell in each hand with your arm fully extended to the side using a neutral grip.
Your feet should be shoulder width apart from each other.
Now slowly lift the dumbbells up until you create a 90 degree angle with your arms.
Note: Your forearms should be perpendicular to the floor.

stiff-legged-barbell-deadlift-2.name: Stiff-Legged Barbell Deadlift
cues: Grasp a bar using an overhand grip (palms facing down).
You may need some wrist wraps if using a significant amount of weight.

squats-with-bands-2.name: Squats - With Bands
cues: To start out.
make sure that the exercise band is at an even split between both the left and right side of the body.
To do this.
use your hands to grab both sides of the band and place both feet in the middle of the band.

front-squat-clean-grip-2.name: Front Squat (Clean Grip)
cues: To begin, first set the bar in a rack slightly below shoulder level.
Rest the bar on top of the deltoids, pushing into the clavicles, and lightly touching the throat.
Your hands should be in a clean grip.
touching the bar only with your fingers to help keep it in position.

anti-gravity-press-2.name: Anti-Gravity Press
cues: Place a bar on the ground behind the head of an incline bench.

flat-bench-cable-flyes-2.name: Flat Bench Cable Flyes
cues: Position a flat bench between two low pulleys so that when you are laying on it.
your chest will be lined up with the cable pulleys.

single-leg-high-box-squat-2.name: Single-Leg High Box Squat
cues: Position a box in a rack.
Secure a band or rope in place above the box.

one-arm-pronated-dumbbell-triceps-extens.name: One Arm Pronated Dumbbell Triceps Extension
cues: Lie flat on a bench while holding a dumbbell at arms length.
Your arm should be perpendicular to your body.
The palm of your hand should be facing towards your feet as a pronated grip is required to perform this exercise.

one-arm-kettlebell-jerk-2.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Jerk
cues: Hold a kettlebell by the handle.
Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder.
Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward.
This will be your starting position.

wide-grip-pulldown-behind-the-neck-2.name: Wide-Grip Pulldown Behind The Neck
cues: Sit down on a pull-down machine with a wide bar attached to the top pulley.
Make sure that you adjust the knee pad of the machine to fit your height.
These pads will prevent your body from being raised by the resistance attached to the bar.

leverage-high-row-2.name: Leverage High Row
cues: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat height so that you can just reach the handles above you.
Adjust the knee pad to help keep you down.
Grasp the handles with a pronated grip.
This will be your starting position.

front-barbell-squat-2.name: Front Barbell Squat
cues: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes.
To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height.
Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded.
bring your arms up under the bar while keeping the elbows high and the upper arm slightly above parallel to the floor.

snatch-from-blocks-2.name: Snatch from Blocks
cues: Begin with a loaded barbell on boxes or stands of the desired height.
A wide grip should be taken on the bar.
The feet should be directly below the hips, with the feet turned out as needed.
Lower the hips, with the chest up and the head looking forward.

smith-machine-calf-raise-2.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
cues: Place a block or weight plate below the bar on the Smith machine.
Set the bar to a position that best matches your height.
Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded.
step onto the plates with the balls of your feet and place the bar on the back of your shoulders.

stride-jump-crossover-2.name: Stride Jump Crossover
cues: Stand to the side of a box with your inside foot on top of it, close to the edge.

cable-rope-rear-delt-rows-2.name: Cable Rope Rear-Delt Rows
cues: Sit in the same position on a low pulley row station as you would if you were doing seated cable rows for the back.

supine-one-arm-overhead-throw-2.name: Supine One-Arm Overhead Throw
cues: Lay on the ground on your back with your knees bent.
Hold the ball with one hand, extending the arm fully behind your head.
This will be your starting position.

dumbbell-alternate-bicep-curl-2.name: Dumbbell Alternate Bicep Curl
cues: Stand (torso upright) with a dumbbell in each hand held at arms length.
The elbows should be close to the torso and the palms of your hand should be facing your thighs.

squat-jerk-2.name: Squat Jerk
cues: Standing with the weight racked on the front of the shoulders, begin with the dip.
With your feet directly under your hips, flex the knees without moving the hips backward.
Go down only slightly, and reverse direction as powerfully as possible.
Drive through the heels create as much speed and force as possible.

smith-machine-upright-row-2.name: Smith Machine Upright Row

split-snatch-2.name: Split Snatch
cues: Begin with a loaded barbell on the floor.
The bar should be close to or touching the shins, and a wide grip should be taken on the bar.
The feet should be directly below the hips, with the feet turned out as needed.
Lower the hips, with the chest up and the head looking forward.

calf-raises-with-bands-2.name: Calf Raises - With Bands
cues: Grab an exercise band and stand on it with your toes making sure that the length of the band between the foot and the arms is the same for both sides.

box-jump-multiple-response-2.name: Box Jump (Multiple Response)
cues: Assume a relaxed stance facing the box or platform approximately an arm's length away.
Arms should be down at the sides and legs slightly bent.

bicycling-2.name: Bicycling
cues: To begin, seat yourself on the bike and adjust the seat to your height.

seated-palms-down-barbell-wrist-curl-2.name: Seated Palms-Down Barbell Wrist Curl
cues: Hold a barbell with both hands and your palms facing down; hands spaced about shoulder width.

arnold-dumbbell-press-2.name: Arnold Dumbbell Press
cues: Sit on an exercise bench with back support and hold two dumbbells in front of you at about upper chest level with your palms facing your body and your elbows bent.
Tip: Your arms should be next to your torso.
The starting position should look like the contracted portion of a dumbbell curl.

cross-body-hammer-curl-2.name: Cross Body Hammer Curl
cues: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand.
Your hands should be down at your side with your palms facing in.

dumbbell-lunges-2.name: Dumbbell Lunges
cues: Stand with your torso upright holding two dumbbells in your hands by your sides.
This will be your starting position.

bent-over-barbell-row-2.name: Bent Over Barbell Row
cues: Holding a barbell with a pronated grip (palms facing down).
bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward.
Tip: Make sure that you keep the head up.
The barbell should hang directly in front of you as your arms hang perpendicular to the floor and your torso.

bent-over-two-arm-long-bar-row-2.name: Bent Over Two-Arm Long Bar Row
cues: Put weight on one of the ends of an Olympic barbell.
Make sure that you either place the other end of the barbell in the corner of two walls.
or put a heavy object on the ground so the barbell cannot slide backward.

split-clean-2.name: Split Clean
cues: With a barbell on the floor close to the shins, take an overhand grip just outside the legs.
Lower your hips with the weight focused on the heels.
back straight.
This will be your starting position.

close-grip-ez-bar-curl-with-band-2.name: Close-Grip EZ-Bar Curl with Band
cues: Attach a band to each end of the bar.
Take the bar, placing a foot on the middle of the band.
Stand upright with a narrow, supinated grip on the EZ bar.
The elbows should be close to the torso.

seated-barbell-military-press-2.name: Seated Barbell Military Press
cues: Sit on a Military Press Bench with a bar behind your head and either have a spotter give you the bar (better on the rotator cuff this way) or pick it up yourself carefully with a pronated grip (palms facing forward).
Tip: Your grip should be wider than shoulder width and it should create a 90-degree angle between the forearm and the upper arm as the barbell goes down.

chair-squat-2.name: Chair Squat
cues: To begin, first set the bar to a position that best matches your height.
Once the bar is loaded, step under it and position it across the back of your shoulders.

cable-lying-triceps-extension-2.name: Cable Lying Triceps Extension
cues: Lie on a flat bench and grasp the straight bar attachment of a low pulley with a narrow overhand grip.
Tip: The easiest way to do this is to have someone hand you the bar as you lay down.

barbell-curl-2.name: Barbell Curl
cues: Stand up with your torso upright while holding a barbell at a shoulder-width grip.
The palm of your hands should be facing forward and the elbows should be close to the torso.
This will be your starting position.

seated-flat-bench-leg-pull-in-2.name: Seated Flat Bench Leg Pull-In
cues: Sit on a bench with the legs stretched out in front of you slightly below parallel and your arms holding on to the sides of the bench.
Your torso should be leaning backwards around a 45-degree angle from the bench.
This will be your starting position.

runners-stretch-2.name: Runner's Stretch
cues: It's easiest to get into this stretch if you start standing up.
put one leg behind you.

leverage-incline-chest-press-2.name: Leverage Incline Chest Press
cues: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height.
The handles should be near the top of the pectorals at the beginning of the motion.
Your chest and head should be up and your shoulder blades retracted.
This will be your starting position.

bent-arm-barbell-pullover-2.name: Bent-Arm Barbell Pullover
cues: Lie on a flat bench with a barbell using a shoulder grip width.

groin-and-back-stretch-2.name: Groin and Back Stretch
cues: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet together.

incline-push-up-depth-jump-2.name: Incline Push-Up Depth Jump
cues: For this drill you will need a box about 12 inches high, and two thick mats or aerobics steps.

clean-2.name: Clean
cues: With a barbell on the floor close to the shins.
take an overhand (or hook) grip just outside the legs.
Lower your hips with the weight focused on the heels.
back straight.

bent-over-one-arm-long-bar-row-2.name: Bent Over One-Arm Long Bar Row
cues: Put weight on one of the ends of an Olympic barbell.
Make sure that you either place the other end of the barbell in the corner of two walls.
or put a heavy object on the ground so the barbell cannot slide backward.

side-wrist-pull-2.name: Side Wrist Pull
cues: This stretch works best standing.
Cross your left arm over the midline of your body and hold the left wrist in your right hand down at the level of your hips.
Start the stretch with a bent left arm.

barbell-hip-thrust-2.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
cues: Begin seated on the ground with a bench directly behind you.
Have a loaded barbell over your legs.
Using a fat bar or having a pad on the bar can greatly reduce the discomfort caused by this exercise.

kneeling-jump-squat-2.name: Kneeling Jump Squat
cues: Begin kneeling on the floor with a barbell racked across the back of your shoulders.
or you can use your body weight for this exercise.
This can be done inside of a power rack to make unracking easier.

cable-chest-press-2.name: Cable Chest Press
cues: Adjust the weight to an appropriate amount and be seated, grasping the handles.
Your upper arms should be about 45 degrees to the body, with your head and chest up.
The elbows should be bent to about 90 degrees.
This will be your starting position.

bottoms-up-clean-from-the-hang-position-.name: Bottoms-Up Clean From The Hang Position
cues: Initiate the exercise by standing upright with a kettlebell in one hand.

landmine-180s-3.name: Landmine 180's
cues: Position a bar into a landmine or securely anchor it in a corner.
Load the bar to an appropriate weight.

thigh-abductor-2.name: Thigh Abductor
cues: To begin, sit down on the abductor machine and select a weight you are comfortable with.
When your legs are positioned properly, grip the handles on each side.
Your entire upper body (from the waist up) should be stationary.
This is the starting position.

rhomboids-smr-2.name: Rhomboids-SMR
cues: Lay down with your back on the floor.
Place a foam roll underneath your upper back.
and cross your arms in front of you.
This will be your starting position.

flat-bench-leg-pull-in-2.name: Flat Bench Leg Pull-In
cues: Lie on an exercise mat or a flat bench with your legs off the end.

bench-press-powerlifting-2.name: Bench Press - Powerlifting
cues: Begin by lying on the bench, getting your head beyond the bar if possible.
Tuck your feet underneath you and arch your back.
Using the bar to help support your weight.
lift your shoulder off the bench and retract them.

one-arm-dumbbell-preacher-curl-2.name: One Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl
cues: Grab a dumbbell with the right arm and place the upper arm on top of the preacher bench or the incline bench.
The dumbbell should be held at shoulder length.
This will be your starting position.

see-saw-press-alternating-side-press-2.name: See-Saw Press (Alternating Side Press)
cues: Grab a dumbbell with each hand and stand up erect.

elevated-cable-rows-2.name: Elevated Cable Rows
cues: Get a platform of some sort (it can be an aerobics or calf raise platform) that is around 4-6 inches in height.

alternate-hammer-curl-2.name: Alternate Hammer Curl
cues: Stand up with your torso upright and a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length.
The elbows should be close to the torso.

two-arm-kettlebell-row-2.name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Row
cues: Place two kettlebells in front of your feet.
Bend your knees slightly and then push your butt out as much as possible as you bend over to get in the starting position.

bradfordrocky-presses-2.name: Bradford/Rocky Presses
cues: Sit on a Military Press Bench with a bar at shoulder level with a pronated grip (palms facing forward).
Tip: Your grip should be wider than shoulder width and it should create a 90-degree angle between the forearm and the upper arm as the barbell goes down.
This is your starting position.

sit-squats-2.name: Sit Squats
cues: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
This will be your starting position.

hanging-leg-raise-2.name: Hanging Leg Raise
cues: Hang from a chin-up bar with both arms extended at arms length in top of you using either a wide grip or a medium grip.
The legs should be straight down with the pelvis rolled slightly backwards.
This will be your starting position.

barbell-step-ups-2.name: Barbell Step Ups
cues: Stand up straight while holding a barbell placed on the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) and stand upright behind an elevated platform (such as the one used for spotting behind a flat bench).
This is your starting position.

machine-bicep-curl-2.name: Machine Bicep Curl
cues: Adjust the seat to the appropriate height and make your weight selection.
Place your upper arms against the pads and grasp the handles.
This will be your starting position.

one-arm-kettlebell-clean-2.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Clean
cues: Place a kettlebell between your feet.
As you bend down to grab the kettlebell, push your butt back and keep your eyes looking forward.

incline-push-up-2.name: Incline Push-Up
cues: Stand facing bench or sturdy elevated platform.
Place hands on edge of bench or platform, slightly wider than shoulder width.

scissor-kick-2.name: Scissor Kick
cues: To begin, lie down with your back pressed against the floor or on an exercise mat (optional).
Your arms should be fully extended to the sides with your palms facing down.
Note: The arms should be stationary the entire time.

smith-machine-hang-power-clean-2.name: Smith Machine Hang Power Clean
cues: Position the bar at knee height and load it to an appropriate weight.

standing-low-pulley-deltoid-raise-2.name: Standing Low-Pulley Deltoid Raise
cues: Start by standing to the right side of a low pulley row.
Use your left hand to come across the body and grab a single handle attached to the low pulley with a pronated grip (palms facing down).
Rest your arm in front of you.
Your right hand should grab the machine for better support and balance.

triceps-pushdown-v-bar-attachment-2.name: Triceps Pushdown - V-Bar Attachment
cues: Attach a V-Bar to a high pulley and grab with an overhand grip (palms facing down) at shoulder width.

seated-hamstring-2.name: Seated Hamstring
cues: In a seated position with your legs extended, have your partner stand behind you.
Now, lean forward as your partner braces your shoulders with their hands.
This will be your starting position.

wide-grip-rear-pull-up-2.name: Wide-Grip Rear Pull-Up
cues: Grab the pull-up bar with the palms facing forward using a wide grip.

seated-close-grip-concentration-barbell-.name: Seated Close-Grip Concentration Barbell Curl
cues: Sit down on a flat bench with a barbell or E-Z Bar in front of you in between your legs.
Your legs should be spread with the knees bent and the feet on the floor.

smith-machine-decline-press-2.name: Smith Machine Decline Press
cues: Position a decline bench in the rack so that the bar will be above your chest.
Load an appropriate weight and take your place on the bench.

standing-pelvic-tilt-2.name: Standing Pelvic Tilt
cues: Start off with your feet hip-distance apart.

jerk-balance-2.name: Jerk Balance
cues: This drill helps you learn to drive yourself low enough during the jerk and corrects those who move backward during the movement.
Begin with the bar racked in the jerk position.
with the shoulders forward.

overhead-lat-2.name: Overhead Lat
cues: Sit upright on the floor with your partner behind you.
Raise one arm straight up, and flex the elbow, attempting to touch your hand to your back.
Your parner should hold your tricep and wrist.
This will be your starting position.

prowler-sprint-2.name: Prowler Sprint
cues: Place your sled on an appropriate surface, loaded to a suitable weight.
The sled should provide enough resistance to require effort.
but not so heavy that you are significantly slowed down.

side-lying-floor-stretch-2.name: Side-Lying Floor Stretch
cues: First lie on your left side.
bending your left knee in front of you to stabilize your torso (use your abdominal muscles as well to hold you upright).

box-skip-2.name: Box Skip
cues: You will need several boxes lined up about 8 feet apart.

side-hop-sprint-2.name: Side Hop-Sprint
cues: Stand to the side of a cone or hurdle.

reverse-flyes-with-external-rotation-2.name: Reverse Flyes With External Rotation
cues: To begin.
lie down on an incline bench set at a 30-degree angle with the chest and stomach pressing against the incline.
